name: std::span<T,Extent>::back
intro:
Returns a reference to the last element in the span.

Calling back on an empty span results in undefined behavior.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A reference to the back element.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: For a span c, the expression c.back() is equivalent to *(c.end() - 1).

summary: Returns a reference to the last element in the span.
